Antique and Classic Car Restoration

ABDY 900:

0.0 Units

Instructional materials fee of $100 is required for this course and must be paid at registration. A class designed for the automotive antique and classic car hobbyist to develop skills and knowledge with emphasis on antique and classic car restoration. The successful student will be able to safely use auto body hand tools, power and hydraulic equipment, MIG weld auto body sheet metal, align and repair automotive body panels using plastic body fillers, and mix and apply automotive undercoats. (R unlimited)
